import pandas as pd
import csv

# Read the raw Eurostat data
input_file = 'outputs/t02_eurostat_raw.csv'
output_file = 'outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv'

df = pd.read_csv(input_file)

# Pivot to wide format: city_id, city_name, year as index, indicator_id as columns, value as values
pivot_df = df.pivot_table(
    index=['city_id', 'city_name', 'year'],
    columns='indicator_id',
    values='value',
    aggfunc='first'
)

# Reset index to make city_id, city_name, year regular columns
pivot_df = pivot_df.reset_index()

# Write to CSV with RFC 4180 compliant quoting (QUOTE_MINIMAL quotes only when necessary)
with open(output_file, 'w', newline='', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    writer = csv.writer(f, quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL)
    # Write header
    writer.writerow(pivot_df.columns.tolist())
    # Write data rows
    for _, row in pivot_df.iterrows():
        writer.writerow(row.tolist())
